assessments.reasoning: Authenticity follows from publisher_live at `https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode.txt`. Integrity follows from its whole-file digest matching the scoped revision and its [5884,6024) digest matching the supplied section 4(a) digest. Relevance comes from 4(a) naming both patent and trademark rights. Interpretation follows from its separate waiver and licensing verbs and its document-wide closing phrase. Applicability follows from “held by Affirmer” in 4(a) and the Statement of Purpose identifying the person applying CC0 to the Work. The contradiction check found that sections 2 and 3 reach the Affirmer's Copyright and Related Rights, section 1(iv) preserves the 4(a) limitation, and section 4(c) addresses third-party clearance separately.

limitations: The finding concerns the instrument's stated effect when an Affirmer applies CC0 to a Work. Ownership, separate grants, defenses, and clearance of rights held by others require separate evidence.
reasoning: Section 4(a) expressly excludes trademark and patent rights “held by Affirmer” from being “waived, abandoned, surrendered, licensed or otherwise affected by this document”. That wording covers both the dedication's waiver and its fallback license.
